_meta.description: Authority-grounding bridge for Estonia EE compiler rules. Maps an EE rule_id (an `ee_*` _RULE constant in src/lawvm/estonia/peg.py or grafter.py) to its drafting/legal-technique authority. This is the source-only authority layer (AGENTS.md 2.1), the grounding counterpart to the spec-discovery ledger's `believed_spec`, modelled on data/uk/spec_authority_grounding.json. Unlike the UK map (grounded in OPC drafting guidance), EE has no acquired external good-legislative-drafting source: there is no Estonia equivalent of notes/UK_OFFICIAL_DRAFTING_SOURCE_LEDGER.md, and neither the EE living spec nor the EE code cites HÕNTE (Hea õigusloome ja normitehnika eeskiri) or Riigi Teataja / Riigikogu drafting conventions for any rule. Every EE rule is therefore grounded only in the EE frontend living spec's own rule statement (authority_kind=internal_spec). This is reported honestly rather than padded with invented external citations.

authority_kinds.external: rule_id is grounded in a documented external good-legislative-drafting authority (HÕNTE / Riigi Teataja / Riigikogu convention) that the living spec or code actually references
authority_kinds.internal_spec: rule_id is grounded only in the EE frontend living spec's own rule statement; no external drafting authority is documented

status_legend.HAVE: rule behavior is implemented/verified per the living spec
status_legend.GAP: not handled / partial per the living spec
status_legend.SPEC: diagnostic / evidence-lane / known-limitation, no settled body replay

_meta.source_ref_convention: ESTONIA_FRONTEND_LIVING_SPEC.md §N (section number of the rule statement)
_meta.honesty_note: 16 of these rule_ids are named explicitly by rule_id in the living spec; the rest are grounded by behavioral match to the nearest living-spec section. No EE rule has an external HÕNTE/RT drafting-authority citation because none is acquired or referenced; padding with one would be inventing legal authority (AGENTS.md §0).
_meta.ledger_section_convention: the EE living spec heading number the rule_id is grounded in
